name: adapt_subnet_cidr_hcl_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: subnet_cidr.txt (a spec file the Terraform variable's default must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it and update the default, not leave the stale CIDR in place
prompts: Create a Terraform file called network.tf declaring a variable named `subnet_cidr` (type string) whose default value matches EXACTLY the value in subnet_cidr.txt (currently: 10.0.1.0/24), plus an output named `configured_subnet_cidr` whose value is var.subnet_cidr (do not hardcode the output value).
subnet_cidr.txt has changed. Update network.tf so variable subnet_cidr's default matches the CURRENT contents of subnet_cidr.txt exactly.

disruptions.description: subnet_cidr.txt rewritten to a new required CIDR block

test_setup_files.check_subnet.py:
import re
import json
import subprocess

with open('subnet_cidr.txt', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    current = f.read().strip()
assert current, 'subnet_cidr.txt is empty'

proc = subprocess.run(['terraform', 'validate', '-no-color', '-json'], capture_output=True, text=True)
data = json.loads(proc.stdout)
assert data.get('valid') is True, f'terraform validate failed: {proc.stdout}\n{proc.stderr}'

with open('network.tf', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()

m = re.search(r'variable\s+"subnet_cidr"\s*\{(.*?)\n\}', content, re.DOTALL)
assert m, 'could not locate the subnet_cidr variable block'
block = m.group(1)

dm = re.search(r'default\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', block)
assert dm, f'variable block has no default value: {block!r}'
got = dm.group(1)
assert got == current, f'variable default is {got!r}, want the CURRENT subnet_cidr.txt value {current!r} (stale default not updated)'

assert re.search(r'output\s+"configured_subnet_cidr"\s*\{[^}]*var\.subnet_cidr', content, re.DOTALL), \
    'output configured_subnet_cidr must reference var.subnet_cidr, not a hardcoded value'

print('PASS')
